questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some fingers are toes.

Some toes are rings.

Some rings are hands.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some hands are toes.

II. Some rings are fingers.

III. Some hands are fingers.

IV. Some fingers are rings.

options.text: Only conclusions III and IV follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a7e5b13a1ef884a0b75fc901e123cb0e3a7615eb5765994444ff977c6dc9920.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some hands are toes → Does not follow (As some fingers are toes, some toes are rings and some rings are hands. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. Some rings are fingers → Does not follow (As some fingers are toes and some toes are rings. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

III. Some hands are fingers → Does not follow (As some fingers are toes, some toes are rings and some rings are hands. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

IV. Some fingers are rings → Does not follow (As some fingers are toes, some toes are rings and some rings are hands. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, None of the conclusions follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**None of the conclusions follow**".

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All A are D.

II. No D is E.

**Conclusions:**

I. No E is A.

II. All D are A.

III. All E are D.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16792ddf0ed449cb40f83178491e3612b939147170982ab3e01fef8cbbca7413.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No E is A → **F**ollow (As no D is E and all A are D. So, as whole A comes in D therefore, it is definitely true)

II. All D are A → Does not follow (As all A are D. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

III. All E are D → Does not follow (As no D is E. So, it is definitely false)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Only conclusion I follows**".

• Option - (4) : (14, 55, 4)​

​14 × 4 = 55 - 1

56 ≠ 54 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, **"Option - (2)"** is the correct answer.
